question: Could you help me find the sellers who excel in the following categories, considering only delivered orders: the seller with the highest number of distinct customer unique IDs, the seller with the highest profit (calculated as price minus freight value), the seller with the highest number of distinct orders, and the seller with the most 5-star ratings? For each category, please provide the seller ID and the corresponding value, labeling each row with a description of the achievement.
sql:
WITH delivered_items AS (
    SELECT oi.*, o.customer_id, o.order_status
    FROM olist_order_items oi
    JOIN olist_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
-- Seller with highest distinct customers
top_customer AS (
    SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as cnt
    FROM delivered_items
    GROUP BY seller_id
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Seller with highest profit
top_profit AS (
    SELECT seller_id, SUM(price - freight_value) as profit
    FROM delivered_items
    GROUP BY seller_id
    ORDER BY profit DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Seller with highest distinct orders
top_orders AS (
    SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) as cnt
    FROM delivered_items
    GROUP BY seller_id
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
-- Seller with most 5-star ratings
top_rating AS (
    SELECT oi.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT orr.review_id) as cnt
    FROM delivered_items oi
    JOIN olist_order_reviews orr ON oi.order_id = orr.order_id
    WHERE orr.review_score = 5
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT seller_id as VALUE FROM top_customer
UNION ALL
SELECT seller_id as VALUE FROM top_profit
UNION ALL
SELECT seller_id as VALUE FROM top_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT seller_id as VALUE FROM top_rating
